newsitem.title: USA: Transco says 650 mmcfd gas cut in USG.
newsitem.headline: Transco says 650 mmcfd gas cut in USG.

text.p: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp (Transco), a unit of Williams Cos, said Monday producers have cut about 650 million cubic feet/day (mmcfd) of natural gas output in the U.S. Gulf due to Tropical Storm Josephine.
"Today, there's about 650 million shut in, but it doesn't look like it's going any higher. It should start to go down as the storm moves farther east," a company spokesman said.
He said about 250 mmcfd was cut Saturday, with the total rising to 450 mmcfd Sunday.
There were no reports of any damage, he added.

At 1100 EDT, Tropical Storm Josephine, with winds rising to 70 mph, was 175 miles south-southwest of Apalachicola, Florida, and moving northeast at 23 mph. Forecasters said it was likely to become a hurricane before making landfall sometime Monday night.
